hebrewText: לוּלֵ֡י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ/י֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וּ/פַ֤חַד יִצְחָק֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔/י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רֵיקָ֣ם שִׁלַּחְתָּ֑/נִי אֶת עָנְיִ֞/י וְ/אֶת יְגִ֧יעַ כַּפַּ֛/י רָאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/יּ֥וֹכַח אָֽמֶשׁ

tokens.bdb: if not
tokens.kjv: except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.

tokens.kjv: Isaac. Compare H3446 (יִשְׂחָק).

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly
tokens.kjv: without cause, empty, in vain, void.

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
